shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && test -f ../round-brief.md && sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md || true && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "(command -v lore-query-trace || true) && rg -n -C 5 \"lastUsage|afterModelResponse|UsageMetadata\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts && rg --files | rg 'turnUsage|chatOrchestrator|test-commands|spec\\.md"'$|CHANGELOG'"' && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && git log -1 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,120p' package.json && rg -n \"afterModelResponse|Usage reported|Measured semantics\" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"Validates specs/|specs/.*#\" src --glob '*test.ts' | head -80 && sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,90p' CHANGELOG.md && rg --files scripts/spec-links || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short --branch'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): aggregate turn usage" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
